root_cause: Original portal Control Plane browser code sent only same-origin credentials with no Netlify Identity Bearer JWT; backend invoked getUser() without original Request.

observed_evidence.claim_boundary: 401 logs do not prove which visitor made each request

fix: Reuse existing ensureIdentityWidget, currentUser.jwt and bearer header on same endpoint, require GET and validate request JWT through getUser(request), preserve admin role gate and Supabase server-side role.
prevention_rules: No admin data request without a real current Identity user JWT
No legacy ambient getUser() when original Request is available
Do not infer authenticated portal readback or revenue from HTTP 401/403
Endpoint remains admin-only, read-only, with same-origin and no JWT leak
No extra scheduler, publisher, data store or second portal
Protected merge, exact Netlify runtime SHA and independent authenticated browser 200 are separate evidence gates

production_readback: NOT_VERIFIED: require exact protected main/Netlify and authenticated owner browser HTTP 200 + 401/403

evidence.observation: 49 401s and 2 499s observed by Netlify for original control plane URL; release source inspected
